# Ziiro AI

> Ziiro AI works in three stages for startups, solo founders and founder-led
> teams: Diagnose maps how the business actually runs and prices the
> opportunity, Build ships agents into the operation, and Optimize keeps them
> measured and tuned. We only build technology when the numbers prove it's
> worth it, and every engagement ships a working, measured system, not a
> slide deck.

The order is the product: understand the business, find the bottlenecks,
quantify the ROI, then build only what the numbers justify. We turn down work
when the math doesn't support it.

## Start here
- [Ziiro AI](https://ziiro.work): AI that has to pay for itself. The agent directory behind the work — the jobs, agents and departments we actually run — and the ask: an hourly consultation.
- [Contact](https://ziiro.work/contact): Book a paid AI strategy consultation, billed hourly with a 60-minute minimum, at rates set by region (India, United States, and a global rate). We identify your operational bottlenecks, estimate the ROI of automating them, show where AI actually creates value, and say what shouldn't be automated. No pitch, and you keep the roadmap. aniket@ziiro.work · govind@ziiro.work · India · worldwide.

## Watch
- [How Ziiro works, in full](https://ziiro.work/watch/how-ziiro-works): An eight-minute screen-share walkthrough of the whole business in the order you'd actually ask about it: what we do and what we deliberately don't, how an engagement runs start to finish, what you invest and how scope gets set, and where your data goes and who can see it.

## What we do
- [Products](https://ziiro.work/products): What gets built, in three stages, and everything we make sits in one of them. Diagnose (operations map, KPI baselines, ROI models, role diagnostics, build roadmap; you leave with a roadmap and a spec, whether or not we build it). Build (workflow agents, research and enrichment, routing and follow-up, stack integration, dashboards and controls; you leave with a running system, the access to it and its documentation). Optimize (outcome tracking, test loops, auto-tuned campaigns, learning reports; you leave with a measurement cycle running on a cadence you agreed to).
- [Docs](https://ziiro.work/docs): The reference page, in eight sections: getting started, service documentation with typical build times, the AI audit methodology with its seven phases and terms, the engagement process, the pricing FAQs, guides built around the eight-minute walkthrough, implementation, and the eight-layer technical stack. Every section on the page carries confirmed content.
- [Pricing](https://ziiro.work/pricing): One published rate for the hour, then a scope. The consultation is billed hourly with a 60-minute minimum at rates set by region; project work is quoted after it, one stage at a time, and there is no fixed project pricing and no menu. Diagnose (typical span 1 to 3 weeks), Build (4 to 12 weeks), Optimize (runs in cycles, not to a finish date).

## Who it's for
- SaaS and software startups, solo founders, founder-led agencies, consulting and professional services, and AI-first service businesses. Lean teams, roughly 5-500 people, that want measurable outcomes rather than AI for its own sake.

## Company
- [Who We Are](https://ziiro.work/who-we-are): Who you are actually hiring and how an engagement runs. The operators who do the work, what we help with, the process phase by phase from understanding how the business runs to a prioritized roadmap, why work with us, and how to reach the team directly. An eight-minute screen-share walkthrough of how Ziiro works end to end (what we do, how we work, what you invest, where your data goes), and the eight-layer stack we build on, in which the reasoning model is one interchangeable layer rather than the advantage.
- [Mission](https://ziiro.work/mission): Why the company exists and what it refuses to do. We don't sell AI, we sell results, and AI without business intelligence is expensive guessing. Five principles we work by, and four kinds of work we turn down: a build with no baseline, automation that moves a bottleneck instead of removing it, AI where arithmetic would do, and work the numbers don't support.
- [Careers](https://ziiro.work/careers): There are no open roles. Why the page is empty (a hire is a system and the numbers do not currently clear), an honest guess at what the first role would be when it opens, an operations analyst or a systems engineer, what earns a reply in the meantime, and the two published addresses to write to. No application form and no applicant tracker.
